Each question: one primary concept (the slot) and optional secondary tags. Record `setup` (one abstract line, no numbers or story) and `variant` on every question. Provide a python verification script. typeFocus ranks question types by practice need (miss rate plus slowness against pace): put the weakest review words / skills / concepts on the slots of the top two types (need >= 0.4), so the practice lands where it is needed.
